question: What sacrificial merit accrues to one who sees the million-liṅga?
premises: A person may see the million-liṅga
The vājapeya sacrifice yields a specific fruit
Seeing the million-liṅga yields that fruit
inference: One who sees the million-liṅga obtains the fruit of the vājapeya sacrifice.
plain_english: Whoever would see the million-liṅga would obtain the fruit of the vājapeya sacrifice.
